newsitem.title: USA: Phillips-Van Heusen to boost marketing.
newsitem.headline: Phillips-Van Heusen to boost marketing.

text.p: Phillips-Van Heusen Corp said on Wednesday that it expects to increase its marketing spending in the second half of the year by $20 million, compared with last year.
Total marketing spending for fiscal 1997 ending January 1998 will be about $40 million, the company said.
"While this doubling of our marketing investment will restrain earnings growth in the short-term, the long-term benefits should be significant," the company said in a statement.
Phillips-Van Heusen said the company is in the early stages of a financial turnaround and that its brands of shirts and shoes are strengthening.
The company cuts its losses in the first quarter, which is traditionally its weakest quarter, it said.
